en: What are you sayin'!? The world is all{SAUT}brother and sister, ain't we!?{ATTENTE}
{PAGE}Then you gotta be friendly to demons{SAUT}too, Missy.(*RESPONSE*)
You shouldn't discriminate just 'cause{SAUT}I'm a demon... Don't they teach you{SAUT}that in school...?(*RESPONSE*)
Ho, ho! I'm happy as a ripe plum! You're{SAUT}a nice little lady.(*RESPONSE*)
...Of course. Long as yer with me,{SAUT}you'll see benefits.(*RESPONSE*)
...So who's got the short straw here?{SAUT}Me...?(*RESPONSE*)
...What a lady...(*RESPONSE*)
Ho, ho! If you're happy, so am I!(*RESPONSE*)
If you're bored, then do somethin'{SAUT}else! Why waste time!?(*RESPONSE*)
Argh! I can't take it any longer!{SAUT}I won't forgive ya, even if you're{SAUT}beggin' for it!(*RESPONSE*)
That's right. All ya had to do was{SAUT}apologize.(*RESPONSE*)
The old man isn't even in the picture,{SAUT}eh...?(*RESPONSE*)
It's nice to be worried about... You're{SAUT}a kind young lady, Missy.(*RESPONSE*)
Reassurance like that just makes me{SAUT}miserable now...(*RESPONSE*)
You're goin' that far!? Then I'll dig{SAUT}up my ol' supremacy and show you!(*RESPONSE*)
Eh? You say they've got skin-care{SAUT}products these days? That's somethin'.(*RESPONSE*)
Burnin' your skin with the sun sounds{SAUT}like crazy talk to us demons.(*RESPONSE*)
No, no. That's your charm. I like it.(*RESPONSE*)
It is! I like pure, Japanese girls!(*RESPONSE*)
Think you get it? Women do have two{SAUT}sides, after all...(*RESPONSE*)
...Alright, I admit, I'm just an old-{SAUT}fashioned demon...(*RESPONSE*)
That's true, but... you're pretty calm.(*RESPONSE*)
I know that. I'm just happy to feel my{SAUT}heart throb for the first time in forever.(*RESPONSE*)
No! It won't work! Love between a human{SAUT}and a [FFF0] is taboo. We'd have{SAUT}a terrible split...(*RESPONSE*)
Good girl. When that day comes, I'll be{SAUT}sure and deliver it to ya.(*RESPONSE*)
Hey! Don't get picky now!{ATTENTE}
{PAGE}There are plenty of demons out there{SAUT}havin' a tougher go of it than you!(*RESPONSE*)
What a high-maintenance girl... Tell{SAUT}ya what, I'll make a cake if ya stop{SAUT}the waterworks.(*RESPONSE*)
That was a firm reply, but are you{SAUT}really independent? I'm worried...(*RESPONSE*)
If you say this is how you like it, then{SAUT}I'm gonna stop caring!(*RESPONSE*)
I understand wanting to shelter a child,{SAUT}but people gotta grow, too.(*RESPONSE*)
Ooh! Just like you said! There's a food{SAUT}called bagels! Eastern and western{SAUT}cultures can be so diverse!(*RESPONSE*)
Hey! I ain't Japanese! I'm a demon!(*RESPONSE*)
What's makin' that 'ding' sound? Is{SAUT}there a monk with a bell trapped in{SAUT}there...?(*RESPONSE*)
Hohoho, it wouldn't be so hard if you{SAUT}could say it yourself. You're a strange{SAUT}little lady.(*RESPONSE*)
Well, that's how it is.(*RESPONSE*)
Nope, not always. Even if they're{SAUT}small, an aura of strength is deceiving.(*RESPONSE*)
Argh! Missy, you've said all that I can{SAUT}take. I've had it with ya!(*RESPONSE*)
I ain't got so much pride...(*RESPONSE*)
If you're just gonna end up apologizing,{SAUT}why'd you use that tactic in the first{SAUT}place!?(*RESPONSE*)
Why!? A good demon like me is hard to{SAUT}come by!(*RESPONSE*)
Well, I AM a demon, but we're not all{SAUT}bad, ya know.(*RESPONSE*)
＊sigh＊ Come on now, don't tease the{SAUT}elderly.(*RESPONSE*)
...You're a genuine bully...(*RESPONSE*)
Hey! I hate bullying!(*RESPONSE*)
Ho, ho! I always wanted to be a bully!{SAUT}Take that! And that! And that too!(*RESPONSE*)
Ho, ho! You're on fire! I see you're{SAUT}quite an accomplished bully!(*RESPONSE*)
Oh, oh, ohhh... I'm old, can't ya{SAUT}be nice?(*RESPONSE*)
...S-So you're a masochist as well,{SAUT}Missy?(*RESPONSE*)
I see, I see. That's good to hear...{SAUT}I'm glad there are reputable men still{SAUT}out there!(*RESPONSE*)
Hohoho... "Women's suffrage," eh? It{SAUT}sounds fancy, but I'm rootin' for ya!(*RESPONSE*)
Hey! I was worried about ya. There's no{SAUT}need to put it like that!(*RESPONSE*)
Argh! Confidence like that'll lower your{SAUT}guard, and that's how ya get hurt!(*RESPONSE*)
Er... I'd like it if you'd talk to{SAUT}me a little longer...(*RESPONSE*)
I must be gettin' old if a little{SAUT}missy is concerned about me...(*RESPONSE*)
Hohoho! You like being considered a{SAUT}greenhorn, Missy!?(*RESPONSE*)
That was just a figure of speech.{SAUT}I wasn't callin' ya a rookie.(*RESPONSE*)
Whatchya ignoring me for...? What a{SAUT}capricious girl...(*RESPONSE*)
Hoho! I like anything that goes well{SAUT}with liquor!(*RESPONSE*)
Yes, I hate 'em! Although I might be{SAUT}interested in a pickled girl! Hohoho!(*RESPONSE*)
Stew? Are you understandin' the words{SAUT}that are comin' outta my mouth!?(*RESPONSE*)
Ho, ho! Are you embarrassed? You are{SAUT}quite a maiden.(*RESPONSE*)
Why'd you get all huffy? I don't{SAUT}understand girls lately...(*RESPONSE*)
That's right. I'm just dandy.(*RESPONSE*)
Hey! If you're gonna deny it, keep right{SAUT}on ignoring me!(*RESPONSE*)
This is quite a shy girl we have here.{SAUT}That's a rarity these days.(*RESPONSE*)
Argh! I'm takin' notice!(*RESPONSE*)
Come now, Missy, you gotta be a little{SAUT}more amiable. Drop that temper of yours.(*RESPONSE*)
...And you're still ignoring me... I'm{SAUT}gonna go sulk.(*RESPONSE*)
Hey! I haven't rotted yet! Stop tryin'{SAUT}to classify me!(*RESPONSE*)
That's right! I've still got wood to{SAUT}burn! I feel more confident already,{SAUT}thanks to you!(*RESPONSE*)
Just as you say... I don't have any{SAUT}passion left to burn...(*RESPONSE*)
That's right! You're a man of virtue!{SAUT}But let's leave it at that...(*RESPONSE*)
...Th-That ain't what I meant... Don't{SAUT}be offended...(*RESPONSE*)
...Never mind...(*RESPONSE*)
If ya don't like it, never mind...(*RESPONSE*)
...You got bad eyes...? Or is it...?(*RESPONSE*)
I'm a rat!? I won't stand for this!(*RESPONSE*)
There are some cruel humans out there...(*RESPONSE*)
If I were reborn, I'd have another life{SAUT}like this...? Noooo!(*RESPONSE*)
Is that so!? I'm glad to hear there's{SAUT}a second life. Makes me happy.(*RESPONSE*)
Ugh! Wh-What are you doing!?(*RESPONSE*)
Blergh... Wh-Why'd you deck me outta{SAUT}the blue like that...?(*RESPONSE*)
S-Stop that, please! I beg of ya!(*RESPONSE*)
I-I apologize... Pretend ya never heard{SAUT}that...(*RESPONSE*)
All you have to do is apologize, but{SAUT}you're too much of a big shot to do{SAUT}that...? I don't like you...(*RESPONSE*)
You've pushed me too far! Now it's the{SAUT}pride of the [FFF0]we're dealin' with!{SAUT}I've got myself a challenge!(*RESPONSE*)
No matter what you say... I was born a{SAUT}demon, and there's nothin' that can{SAUT}change that...(*RESPONSE*)
That's right! Exactly! Ya can't judge{SAUT}something by good or evil alone!(*RESPONSE*)
If it's got nothin' to do with me, then{SAUT}leave me out of it... Catch my drift?(*RESPONSE*)
...I was bein' set up?(*RESPONSE*)
Hohoho! See, just as I thought. You{SAUT}can't fool these eagle eyes.(*RESPONSE*)
I-I get it... I-I'll listen... You don't{SAUT}have to scream...(*RESPONSE*)
So THAT'S your negotiation technique?{SAUT}There sure are strange humans out there.(*RESPONSE*)
Which means... you're just an oddball!{SAUT}Someone do sometin' about this guy!(*RESPONSE*)
Is that so...? Still, you're quite the{SAUT}annoying young man...(*RESPONSE*)
Hrrmm... "Die..." I'm gonna die!?(*RESPONSE*)
Hrm... I'm hungry...? Give me a card...{SAUT}I don't know.(*RESPONSE*)
...How primitive...(*RESPONSE*)
...You're pretty stingy...(*RESPONSE*)
